title: {{NAME}} and the Crown Lost in the Clouds
moral: Being brave for someone else is the greatest thing of all.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} soared above the clouds.
Below him sat a shining castle.
A princess called up to him from the tower.
Her golden crown had blown away in the wind.
A white unicorn stood below looking up sadly.

They flew back to the castle.
{{NAME}} placed the crown on the princess's head.
She clapped her hands with joy.

{{NAME}} curled up against its warm side.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. You were so brave.
I wonder where the unicorn will fly you next time.
